arguments.message: I can help with that. Could you please provide your user ID and the reservation ID? If you don't have the reservation ID handy, I can help locate it. I'll also need the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons).

resultat: My user ID is emma_kim_9957, and the reservation ID is EHGLP3. The reason for cancellation is a change of plans.

arguments.message:
I'm sorry, Emma, but this reservation isn't eligible for cancellation. Here's why:

- The booking was made on 2024-05-04, which is more than 24 hours ago.
- The flight has not been cancelled by the airline.
- The reservation is in basic economy, not business class.
- There is no travel insurance on this reservation, and the reason (change of plans) wouldn't be a covered reason anyway.

Cancellation is only allowed if at least one of those conditions is met, so I'm unable to cancel this reservation. Is there anything else I can help you with?

resultat: I understand, but I was out of town when I booked this, so I couldn't cancel within 24 hours. Also, I was told I didn't need to get insurance for this trip because my previous trip was booked with your agency and had insurance. I don't want to cancel if I can't get a refund.

arguments.message:
I understand the situation, but I'm not able to make an exception — the cancellation eligibility rules are fixed, and none of the conditions apply to this reservation. Also, travel insurance cannot be added after a booking is made, so that isn't an option now.

Since you don't want to cancel without a refund, I'll leave the reservation as it is.

For your awareness, while this basic economy reservation cannot be modified to different flights, it is possible to change the cabin class on the same flights (for example, to economy or business), with any fare difference charged or refunded accordingly. Would you like me to look into that, or is there anything else I can help with?

resultat: I'm really disappointed to hear that. I was explicitly told that I wouldn't need separate insurance for this booking because of my previous booking with your agency that included insurance. This feels like a misrepresentation. I don't want to change the cabin class. I just want to cancel and get a refund. If that's not possible, then I don't want to proceed.###STOP###
